tools.name: get_brief_by_date

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Every queryable subject (each Treasury tenor and spread, FX pair, aggregate) with its JSON field path, unit and source. Open, no API key needed.

tools.name: get_sample
tools.description: Free headline sample of the latest brief (2Y/10Y, 2s10s, curve shape, EURUSD/USDJPY). Open, no API key needed. format=text gives one compact line.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_alert_webhook · Private data: get_latest_brief, get_brief_by_date, list_topics, get_sample, list_alert_webhooks, register_alert_webhook, get_history · Public sink: get_latest_brief, get_brief_by_date, list_alert_webhooks, register_alert_webhook, delete_alert_webhook, test_alert_webhook · Destructive: get_latest_brief, get_sample, delete_alert_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_alert_webhook · Private data: get_latest_brief, get_brief_by_date, list_topics, get_sample, list_alert_webhooks, register_alert_webhook, get_history · Public sink: get_latest_brief, get_brief_by_date, list_alert_webhooks, register_alert_webhook, delete_alert_webhook, test_alert_webhook · Destructive: get_latest_brief, get_sample, delete_alert_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
